# EvCommand

> A command palette (⌘K) lets users search and run actions from anywhere — a searchable, keyboard-navigable list of commands grouped into sections.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:command` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvCommand } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvCommand>` or `<ev-command>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/command/EvCommand.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-command">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvCommand
  placeholder="Ketik perintah untuk mencari"
  :max-height="220"
>
  <EvCommandGroup heading="Saran">
    <EvCommandItem label="Buat faktur baru" active />
    <EvCommandItem label="Cari pemasok" />
  </EvCommandGroup>
</EvCommand>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

Its default slot is built to hold `EvCommandGroup` (`evoq-ui:command-group`).

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Command**, frame `4220:73205` (Command). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Give power users fast keyboard access to actions, navigation, and search across the app — triggered by ⌘K / Ctrl+K from anywhere.

### When not to use

- As the only way to reach an action. On simple apps with few commands — a visible menu or buttons are clearer.

### Do

- Group commands into clear sections. Show keyboard shortcuts (Kbd) for frequent actions. Keep labels action-first (verbs).

### Don't

- Don't bury critical actions only here. Don't list hundreds of flat commands without grouping or search.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvCommand`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-command">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:command` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
